description: Provisional 1.35 legal-frame reaction matrix preserving the 15 frozen 1.34 semantic vectors and adding per-element enemy-resistance and Hydro/Frozen Electro-Charged guard vectors.

provenance.source: genshinsim/gcsim reaction implementation at b4ae769d7c1c1bce68fce5faf0b460c5b5b7f541; per-element resistance behavior is frozen from this repository's 1.35 simulation core
notes: This is a deterministic regression fixture for the checked-in implementation, not official game data or a claim of complete gcsim parity.

The original 15 vectors preserve their 1.34 damage, hit-resolution, reaction-damage, state, target-timeline, aura-boundary, damage-curve, and player hashes; only versioned config and run identities change.

elementalResistance freezes one 2U Electro hit against coexisting Pyro and Cryo with distinct Electro, Pyro, and Cryo base resistances, covering direct, Overload, and Superconduct damage in one ordered aura-v6 vector.

hydroFrozenEcGuard freezes 3U Hydro against coexisting Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Electro as ordered Vaporize, Freeze, then Bloom; Frozen suppresses the post-Freeze Electro-Charged attempt, so no F+10 EC damage is queued while the Bloom core still spawns at F+30.
All vectors explicitly keep targetClockModel disabled; target-local enemy Hitlag remains covered by separate 1.33 unit and integration fixtures.

Player Burning, Bloom, Burgeon, and Hyperbloom self-damage remains modeled against an explicit 10% player-resistance vector with auditable spatial checks, HP transitions, damage groups, and reverse references.
The aura-v6 ordering follows the fixed reference implementation provisionally; it is not asserted as independently verified live-game truth.
Burning preserves the frozen 1.30 compatibility phase difference (F+121 and hit-before-tick ordering).
Lunar reactions, complete Aura source overlap, character ICD databases, particles, action frames, reaction hooks, and complete character/weapon databases remain outside this fixture.
